description:
Create a realistic PBR (Physically Based Rendering) material for the 'GroundPlane' object using the provided texture maps located in '/home/ga/Assets/Textures/'.

The texture set includes:
- diffuse.jpg (Base Color)
- roughness.jpg (Roughness)
- normal.jpg (Normal Map)

Your task:
1. Create a node-based material named 'SandMaterial' for the GroundPlane.
2. Connect all three textures to their respective inputs on the Principled BSDF.
3. Ensure the 'Roughness' and 'Normal' textures are set to the correct Color Space (Non-Color) for physical accuracy.
4. Connect the Normal map through a 'Normal Map' node.
5. Add Mapping and Texture Coordinate nodes to control the mapping of all three textures together.
6. Render the scene to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/pbr_render.png'.
7. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/pbr_material_complete.blend'.
